107:         .filter(|syntax| !syntax.hidden && !syntax.file_extensions.is_empty())
108:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();

110: 
111:     let longest = languages
112:         .iter()
113:         .map(|syntax| syntax.name.len())

117:     let comma_separator = ", ";

122:     let stdout = io::stdout();
